scope: Qualify generated VIEW table-record allocation rollback, caller-state preservation, retry and typed readback across the R14-through-R2018 DXF lanes.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored in-memory DRW_View generated during each test run
source.profile: One VIEW with nondefault camera geometry, UCS coordinates and orthographic type, two XDATA entries, and post-AC1018 default-lighting, brightness, contrast and ambient-index fields.

implementation.method: For each version and encoding, calibrate allocations reached by the public writeView callback, inject failure at every measured offset, verify prior-destination and full caller-state preservation, then retry with the same codec and compare exact bytes plus typed VIEW readback.

validation.directControl: build/tests/libdxfrw_view_table_allocation_tests: PASS; 300 injected allocation offsets across AC1014/15/18/21/24/27/32 ASCII/Binary

limitations: Generated writer transaction evidence only; producer interoperability and native VIEW behavior are not qualified.
No optional background, live-section, visual-style, sun or UCS handle graph is exercised; reference closure remains open.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: The selected VIEW profile survives every measured allocation failure across seven DXF revisions and both encodings, with destination/caller rollback, same-codec retry, and typed readback.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue the exact public-writer inventory and caller-state audit; retain producer, reference-graph, and native semantic gates.
planImpact.progressEstimate: 217 completed slices and 35 remaining packages: 217/(217+35)=86.1%; count-based, not effort-weighted.
